title: Luscious, Tender Polish Duck Gratin
description: A hearty, earthy Polish dish featuring tender duck breast and legs in a rich yuzu-cure and duck fat gratin.

ingredients.name: Sea salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher or flaky sea salt

instructions: Season the duck legs and breast with sea salt and black pepper.
Mix the yuzu zest and juice in a small bowl, then brush the mixture evenly over the duck breast and legs.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck breast for 2-3 minutes per side, until browned, then transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the skillet, then sear the duck legs for 2-3 minutes per side, until browned.
Transfer the duck legs to a 9x13-inch baking dish, then add the seared duck breast on top.
In a small bowl, whisk together the flour and warmed chicken broth until smooth.
Pour the flour mixture over the duck, then pour in the heavy cream, if using.
Dot the top of the gratin with the melted duck fat.
Transfer the dish to the preheated oven and bake for 25-30 minutes, until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
